raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: madoka
  version: "0.7.2.1"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/madoka-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a594f7acd173bc92928c9661ff92ba8b77ac85f2d7697f05ebb07f03184b4a08

build:
  number: 2
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - madoka
      pip_check: true

about:
  summary: Memory-efficient CountMin Sketch key-value structure (based on Madoka C++ library)
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/ikegami-yukino/madoka-python

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
